reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Russ enough! From start to finish, he has been incredibly communicative, knowledgeable, and thoughtful about every aspect of training. He does a fantastic job setting clear expectations, explaining the process, and ensuring you feel supported throughout.
What stands out most is how much he genuinely cares about the long-term well-being and longevity of your pet. Benny was so well cared for, and in just a short amount of time, I’ve already seen a significant, noticeable improvement in his behavior. I’m so grateful for his expertise and the care he put into working with Benny!

Everything about my experience with Russell was amazing. I had no doubt in my mind about the level of care he puts into this process based off of his responsiveness to emails/communications but also the level of detail in the reports he provides.

On top of that he was able to address my main concerns and educate me on how to continue to support Cardi after she returned home. I strongly recommend his services as they provide real results.

Man oh man, Russ is phenomenal. My dog, Barb, and I are lucky to have partnered with Russ the last two weeks for bootcamp. First, his daily reports and resources he provides are informative, up to date, and easy to follow. Second, his daily uploads of photos/videos with commentary is so helpful, my mom knew exactly the number of content uploaded every day.

I recently adopted a 4-year old female rottweiler from a shelter and had not had any basic training, positive engagement/enrichment from humans, and is aggressive and dangerous. Additionally, she resource guards outdoor trash bins, making it impossible to get her on walks.

After being with Russ on his ranch, Barb was avoiding trash bins within a day through recall and tons of TLC. He was able to learn more of Barb's triggers and address them to educate me and those in our household.

We very much look forward to working with Russ very soon!

I am so grateful that I've found Russ. He is so knowledgeable, offers a ton of free resources and guidance online, and has been very communicative with me since we've started. I have a human and dog reactive GSD mix with a high prey drive and an aggressive cat, and I've lived in a divided home for 2 years. It's really difficult to find someone who specializes in both, and I'm so grateful for Russ helping me in slowly introducing my babies so I can finally have a peaceful home. Thank you Russ!

I can’t recommend Fun Paw Care enough! Russell is incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and genuinely cares about both the dogs and their owners. From the very beginning, he treated me like a friend and cared for my dog as if he were his own.

My dog struggled with anxiety and other behavioral issues, and Russell went above and beyond while boarding him. Not only did he provide exceptional care, but he also shared so much helpful advice and guidance that has made a real difference in my dog’s behavior and confidence.

It’s rare to find someone who is so passionate, patient, and experienced. You can tell Russell truly loves what he does, and it shows in the way he cares for every dog. I have complete trust in Fun Paw Care and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a safe, loving, and knowledgeable place for their dog. Thank you, Russell, for everything you’ve done for us!

Incredibly skilled and thorough in breaking down how to make meaningful changes with precision and clarity. Truly an amazing experience that will allow Daisy and me to embrace a remarkable journey together. I am so grateful for Russ and will continue to work with him and take advantage of his services for the long haul.

When my wife and I brought our newborn home after a very taxing birth, we were overwhelmed—and honestly, scared. Our dog was far too interested in the baby, and we didn’t know what to do. We were worried we might have to rehome him.
Then we found Russ.
From the start, Russ took incredible care of our dog, but what really stood out was how thoughtful and thorough his approach was. He trained using positive reinforcement, worked extensively on “stay,” and even incorporated recordings of baby cries into sessions so our dog could safely acclimate. It was clear he wasn’t just going through the motions—he was thinking deeply about our real-life situation.
What we didn’t expect was how much Russ would help us, too. He guided us through the process with patience and clarity, almost like a behaviorist for the whole family. He helped diagnose underlying issues like fear and separation anxiety, and gave us tools—not just quick fixes—that we could actually carry forward.
Russ went far beyond what we thought was possible. He was incredibly available, supportive when we needed him most, and genuinely invested in our outcome.
We stayed consistent with the training and supplements he recommended, and the transformation has been unbelievable. The dog we were once afraid we might lose is now safely and lovingly part of our family in a whole new way.
We’re closer than ever—and we truly have Russ to thank for that.
He’s not just a trainer. He’s a lifesaver.

I don't know how to express my gratitude for Russell enough. He took in my 19 week puppy, Poppy, for a one week bootcamp to get the lay of the land and set her up on a path to becoming a service dog. While one week isn't a ton of time, the amount of growth and development seen in Poppy when she returned home is astonishing. This is because, unlike other bootcamps, Poppy spent the week living with Russ in his home, with no other "clients" present. In other words, she had his full attention for 24h/day for the entire week she was there to really maximize their training time. On top of her staying in his home, he treated her with the highest level of care and love imaginable. All the daily photos and videos showed not only how happy she was being there, but that she was genuinely LOVED.

Aside from Russell taking the absolute best care of Poppy, he also sent daily reports to help me continue our training at home, with links to science backed sources and resources to purchase for different situations. He's made me feel so much more confident in being a part of Poppy's training, and I truly cannot recommend him enough. No matter what life stage or situation your dog is in, I think all dogs and parents would benefit from working with Russ to form a greater connection.

Russell is amazing! His advice and the way he connected with our dog were both incredible. Looking forward to having him help with our new puppy in a few months! Russ makes all the difference and truly makes having a pet something wonderful.

I recently enrolled my 8‑month‑old rescue puppy with Fun Paw Care and I couldn’t be happier with the decision. Russell and the team provided constant updates — photos, short video clips, and clear email summaries of what they were working on and how we could support the training at home.

From day one, it was obvious they weren’t just going through the motions. Russell’s approach is clearly rooted in both science and compassion, with a deep understanding of canine behavior.
My pup was showing signs of anxiety and lack of confidence, and within a week we already began seeing changes: calmer behavior, better recall, and our walks are far less stressful. Even more importantly, I feel empowered — they gave us educational materials and actionable pointers so I know what to keep building on after the training is over.

The facility is spotless, the atmosphere is friendly yet focused, and you can tell the team genuinely loves what they do. If you’re looking for a trainer who will work with your dog (and you) and not just at them, I highly recommend Fun Paw Care. Five stars all the way.
